Debug issues across application code, databases, infrastructure, and third-party APIs.

Make pragmatic architectural decisions while continuing to ship quickly.

Use AI coding agents as a core part of your daily development workflow.

Requirements

What we’re looking for:

Strong backend engineering experience in production environments.

Excellent knowledge of SQL, relational databases, transactions, locking, and data modelling.

Experience with Docker, Linux, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD.

A good understanding of queues, scheduled jobs, APIs, networking, security, and observability.

Confidence reasoning about concurrency, idempotency, partial failures, and recovery.

Strong debugging skills across the full system.

Startup experience or a strong bias toward ownership and execution.

Good product judgment and an instinct for avoiding unnecessary complexity.

Experience using AI coding agents to plan, implement, test, review, and document software.

The ability to critically review, iterate on, and improve AI-generated code until it is high-quality and production-ready.

Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Docker, Linux, and Hack. Experience with every technology is not required, we care more about strong fundamentals and the ability to learn.

AI-native engineering:

Using AI agents is a requirement for this role, not an optional productivity tool.

We expect you to use them throughout the development process: exploring unfamiliar code, planning changes, implementing features, writing tests, investigating failures, reviewing work, and maintaining documentation.

This does not mean accepting generated code without understanding it. You remain responsible for architecture, security, correctness, and production outcomes. We are looking for someone who knows how to give agents useful context, break work into verifiable steps, review their output critically, and use them to increase both speed and quality.

You’ll probably enjoy this role if:

You have worked in an early stage startup/scale-up

You like owning systems after they go live.

You naturally ask what happens when a process crashes halfway through.

You can move between backend code, SQL, infrastructure, and debugging.

You prefer simple, dependable systems over fashionable architecture.

You are excited about developing with AI agents and actively improving how you use them.

Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to build at the intersection of AI, creator technology, and consumer products.

WePush is backed by experienced operators from companies including Spotify, Google and many more. We’re entering our next phase of growth with the ambition, speed, and ownership of a startup, but with a proven product and strong market traction.

As an AI Product Engineer, you won’t be sitting on the sidelines. You’ll work closely with the founders and product team to turn new AI capabilities into products used by brands and creators at scale.

Competitive salary and meaningful equity package

High ownership from day one with the freedom to ship, experiment, and influence product direction

Direct access to founders and leadership with fast decisions and minimal bureaucracy

A team of builders: Ambitious, pragmatic, and obsessed with moving fast

An in-person culture in our Berlin office, with flexibility for home office days

Public transport pass, gym membership, recurring team lunches, and other perks

A front-row seat to building a category-defining technology company

Regardless of who you are, where you come from, how you look, or what music is playing in your headphones, you are welcome.

If you are a builder and move fast, this role is for you.

This position is in the Zoonotic and Vector-Borne Disease Unit (ZVDU) within the Bureau of Communicable Disease (BCD). ZVDU is responsible for overseeing the surveillance for reportable, new, high profile, and emerging vector-borne diseases that are reportable in New York City. Vectorborne diseases include, but are not limited to Lyme disease, babesiosis, anaplasmosis, alpha-gal syndrome and certain high-profile diseases such as legionellosis and cyclosporiasis. ZVDU is recruiting an experienced epidemiologist and data analyst to work under the Research Scientist to perform and enhance Lyme disease surveillance as well as contribute to similar efforts for other vectorborne diseases.
